description: Generate the solet's X25519 identity keypair if absent. Idempotent. Returns the public key.
embedding_description: Idempotent bootstrap of the solet's X25519 identity keypair used for cross-solet sealed-box secret transfer. Generates a fresh keypair only if one is not already stored, then returns the public key (base64) plus a created flag. Safe to call on every boot. The private key never leaves the vault plugin process; only the public key is exposed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Whether the keypair was freshly created plus the X25519 public key
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report whether the keypair was created or already present and present the base64 public key so the operator can hand it to a peer solet.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: If created=True, share the public_key with peer solets that need to send secrets to this one. If created=False, no action needed.
